text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 6) 2016.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 19 Disember 2016 hingga 28 Disember 2016.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

3. Daging kambing biri-biri import tanpa tulang (tidak termasuk paha)

4. Daging paha kambing biri-biri import bertulang

5. Ayam belanda import

6. Tomato

7. Kepak ayam

8. Lada benggala hijau

9. Babi hidup

10. Daging babi (perut)

11. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 16 Disember 2016

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 6) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 6) Order 2016.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 19 December 2016 to 28 December 2016.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported boneless mutton (not including leg)

4. Imported bone-in mutton leg

5. Imported turkey

6. Tomato

7. Chicken wing

8. Green pepper (capsicum)

9. Live pig

10. Pork (belly)

11. Pork (lean and fat)
